maps.name: Quarry Road
maps.description: One wide road cut through solid rock. In from the west, north at the bend, then east to the loading yard. Nowhere for the horde to go but past your guns.

maps.name: Canyon Approach
maps.description: A walled canyon split by five rock masses. Towers hold the rim and the plateaus while the horde funnels between them toward the eastern base.

maps.name: Twin Gullies
maps.description: Two gullies come down out of the northern ridge, meet across the junction floor, and leave as one stem running south to the base. Hold both branches, or give one up and hold the stem.

maps.name: Horseshoe Basin
maps.description: A horseshoe open to the east, with the base at the top of it. Three ways in: the lower mouth walks the whole basin, the south cut joins halfway, and the west breach comes out on the spine with the shortest run left of all.

maps.name: Mesa Canyon
maps.description: One road across the canyon floor, and a loop that climbs out of it and rejoins before the base. Hold both branches thinly, hold one and give up the other, or wall one and meet everything on the road you kept.

maps.name: Hollow Fold
maps.description: Four folds come down out of the ridge, meet across the junction floor and leave as one stem — with a way round the stem that rejoins before the base. No defence covers four heads. Decide which ones do not matter.

maps.name: Yard Road
maps.description: One haul road folded back on itself six times down the yard. No route to choose and nowhere to hide: every band of rock between two runs is a position that fires on the horde twice.

maps.name: Track Diggings
maps.description: Two tracks into the diggings from opposite corners, meeting only where the base stands on the open floor. No shared last stretch, no position that covers both, and no time to be wrong about either.

maps.name: Rimefall Terraces
maps.description: One broad road cut down a frozen hill in five terraces, doubling back at every level. Too wide to hold from one place and too long to hold in one: a defence here is built in depth, terrace by terrace, or not at all.

maps.name: Basin Chute
maps.description: A horseshoe that folds west, down and back across the middle to a base in the north-east corner, with a second road climbing from the south to cross over it on a bridge.

maps.name: Lane Yard
maps.description: Two heads. One drops through a tunnel and a choke into a plaza; the other comes down a braid of channels and crosses over the first on a bridge before they meet at the base.

maps.name: Vale Common
maps.description: Two jaws and a base in the open between them. One comes up through a tunnel, the other through a plaza round an island pad, and they never share a road.

maps.name: Drift Trench
maps.description: The north road rides a bridge over the west one; below it they join and coil in to a base at the heart of the map, through a tunnel on the last lap.

maps.name: Draw Green
maps.description: Three gates. One road splits round an island, one loops north before it drops, one runs straight in, and they meet beside an open yard where barricades decide the line.

maps.name: Test Ground
maps.description: Canyon Approach with every skill bought and hordes of ten to fifty thousand, for seeing how the game holds up at volume.

maps.name: Proving Ground
maps.description: Two roads that cross on a bridge without meeting, a tunnel, a braid and a choke into a plaza: the level builder's new pieces on one map.
